verdict.line: You lose this lane if you let Jayce sit in Cannon stance and poke you down with Shock Blast and Acceleration Gate; you win it by catching his Hammer-stance commitments with E (Disdain) and snowballing the measured solo-kill edge.

brief.thesis: Jayce's threat level is entirely tied to which stance he's in — Hammer form gives him a leap and knockback but drags him into E (Disdain) range, while Cannon form lets him poke safely at 600 range but leaves him with no way to peel off R (Fear Beyond Death)'s execute. Landing E (Disdain) on him before level 3 also procs Passive (Echoing Flames) for free, which is exactly OP.GG's own read on this lane. That stance-locked fragility is the structural reason Urgot sits at a 54.6% win rate over 1193 games here despite being outranged on paper.

theirWindow.when: Jayce in Cannon stance with gate up
theirWindow.what: With E (Acceleration Gate) down and Q (Shock Blast) fired through it, Jayce can poke from well outside your Q (Corrosive Charge)'s 800 range and W (Purge)'s 490 range. Back off and let the wave come to you instead of trading autos into that combo.

yourWindow.when: Jayce in Hammer stance, closing to melee
yourWindow.what: His Q (To the Skies!) leap and E (Thundering Blow) knockback both need him inside roughly 600/240 range. The instant he commits, hit him with E (Disdain) — it stops on the first champion it hits and hurls him out of your path, wasting his cooldown and feeding Passive (Echoing Flames) stacks.

start.why: Doran's Blade over Doran's Shield wins by far more often here (55.3% over 1007 games) because it fuels the early trades you're already favored to win via the solo-kill advantage.

boots.why: Steelcaps (53% WR, 74.1% pick) blunt the sustained auto damage from his W (Lightning Field) tick in Hammer stance and the attack-speed burst from W (Hyper Charge) in Cannon stance.

core.why: Highest-winning path (63.9% over 158 games) — the armor shred compounds with E (Disdain) catches to close out extended duels.

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-sample page (51.2% WR, 20.6% pick) runs Press the Attack, which rewards the repeated auto/Purge trades Urgot wants to force once he's in W (Purge) range.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the dominant pick (53.2% WR, 75.1% pick) and closes out the solo-kill windows this matchup already favors; swap Ignite for Teleport (54.3% WR, 13.9% pick) if you expect to be splitpushing or need to answer sidelane pressure.

playing.title: Punish Hammer-stance approaches with E
playing.detail: When Jayce walks up in Hammer stance to use Q (To the Skies!) or E (Thundering Blow), fire E (Disdain) into him — on hitting a champion it stops and hurls him out of your path, wasting his cooldown and letting you keep farming.

playing.title: Land E before level 3
playing.detail: Connect E (Disdain) on Jayce before he hits level 3 so Passive (Echoing Flames) procs for free extra damage, while he still lacks the full combo needed to punish the commitment.

playing.title: Max W for sustained trades
playing.detail: The common skill order (EWQWWRWEWEREEQQ) puts four points into W (Purge) by level 9. Use it whenever Jayce is forced into its 490 range, since it prioritizes him and keeps triggering Passive (Echoing Flames).

playing.title: Respect Cannon-stance poke
playing.detail: In Cannon stance his Q (Shock Blast) reaches 600 range and gains extra range and damage through his own E (Acceleration Gate). Don't walk up to trade autos into a loaded gate-and-orb combo.

playing.title: Threaten executes with R from level 6
playing.detail: R (Fear Beyond Death) impales the first champion hit at up to 2500 range and can execute him below its health threshold. Flash it in after landing poke to close out trades he thinks he's safe from.

playing.title: Build into his attack-speed bursts
playing.detail: Plated Steelcaps and, if needed, Randuin's Omen blunt the attack-speed spike from W (Hyper Charge) in Cannon stance and the sustained W (Lightning Field) tick in Hammer stance.

playing.title: Snowball off your solo-kill edge
playing.detail: With both lane and solo-kill advantage measured in your favor, play on your cooldown windows aggressively rather than passively — the 54.6% win rate here comes from pressuring, not turtling.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (62,587 Urgot games overall, 1193 vs Jayce); the stance-timing and trade-pattern reasoning is my own tactical read on top of that data.
